cards.name: Water Has Memory
cards.text: Look at the top 4 cards of chosen player's deck. Put one on the top of their deck and the rest on the bottom of their deck in any order.

cards.name: All Is Found
cards.text: (A character with cost 5 or more can {E} to sing this song for free.) Put up to 2 cards from your discard into your inkwell, facedown and exerted.

cards.name: Sapphire Coil
cards.text: BRILLIANT SHINE During your turn, whenever a card is put into your inkwell, you may give chosen character -2 {S} this turn.

cards.name: Baymax's Charging Station
cards.text: ENERGY CONVERTER Whenever you play a Floodborn character, if you used Shift to play them, you may draw a card.

cards.name: Dr. Calico
cards.text: YOU'RE BEGINNING TO IRK ME While this character has no damage, he gains Resist +2. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 2.)

cards.name: Helga Sinclair
cards.text: Challenger +3 (While challenging, this character gets +3 {S}). QUICK REFLEXES During your turn, this character gains Evasive. (They can challenge characters with Evasive.)

cards.name: Bolt
cards.text: THERE'S NO TURNING BACK Whenever this character quests, if he has no damage, you may draw a card, then choose and discard a card.

cards.name: Raya
cards.text: A GREATER PURPOSE During your turn, whenever a card is put into your inkwell, this character gains Resist +1 until the start of your next turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)

cards.name: Tuk Tuk
cards.text: Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted. An opposing character who challenges one of your characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.) Resist +2 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 2.)

cards.name: Fa Zhou
cards.text: TRAINING EXERCISES Whenever one of your characters challenges another character, if it's the second challenge this turn, gain 3 lore.

cards.name: Razoul
cards.text: MY ORDERS COME FROM JAFAR When you play this character, if you have a character named Jafar in play, you may banish chosen item.

cards.name: Jafar
cards.text: THAT'S BETTER When you play this character, chosen character gains Challenger +2 this turn. (They get +2 {S} while challenging.)

cards.name: Tick-Tock
cards.text: LOOKING FOR LUNCH During your turn, this character gains Evasive while a Pirate character is in play. (They can challenge characters with Evasive.)

cards.name: Kakamora
cards.text: SHOWBOATING While you have another Pirate character in play, this character gains Challenger +3. (While challenging, this character gets +3 {S}.)

cards.name: Mulan

cards.name: Orville
cards.text: WELCOME ABOARD, FOLKS During your turn, while you have a character named Miss Bianca or Bernard in play, this character gains Evasive. (They can challenge characters with Evasive.)

cards.name: Miss Bianca
cards.text: HAVE A LITTLE FAITH If you have an Ally character in play, you pay 2 {I} less to play this character.

cards.name: Aladdin
cards.text: HELPING HAND Whenever this character quests, you may play an Ally character with cost 3 or less for free. PUT IN THE EFFORT While this character is exerted, your Ally characters get +1 {S}.

cards.name: Bagheera
cards.text: Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted. An opposing character who challenges one of your characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.) YOU MUST BE BRAVE When this character is banished during an opponent's turn, deal 2 damage to each opposing character.

cards.name: Gantu
cards.text: CLOSE ALL CHANNELS When you play this character, characters can't exert to sing songs until the start of your next turn. DON'T GET ANY IDEAS Each player pays 2 {I} more to play actions or items. (This doesn’t apply to singing songs.)

cards.name: Mickey Mouse
cards.text: STIRRING SPIRIT During your turn, whenever this character banishes another character in a challenge, you may play a character for free.

cards.name: Restoring Atlantis
cards.text: Your characters can't be challenged until the start of your next turn.

cards.name: Double Trouble
cards.text: Deal 1 damage each to up to 2 chosen characters.

cards.name: Aurora
cards.text: Singer 5 (This character counts as cost 5 to sing songs.) SWEET DREAMS Whenever you remove 1 or more damage from a character, ready this character. She can't quest or challenge for the rest of this turn.

cards.name: Mirabel Madrigal
cards.text: Shift 4 (You may pay 4 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Mirabel Madrigal.) HER OWN SPECIAL GIFT Whenever this character quests, you may return a song card with cost 3 or less from your discard to your hand.

cards.name: Bolt
cards.text: Shift 3 (You may pay 3 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Bolt.) MARK OF POWER Whenever you ready this character, gain 1 lore for each other undamaged character you have in play. BOLT STARE {E} — Banish chosen Illusion character.

cards.name: The Glass Slipper
cards.text: PERFECT PAIR You may only have 2 copies of The Glass Slipper in your deck. SEARCH THE KINGDOM Banish this item, {E} one of your Prince characters – Search your deck for a Princess character card and reveal it to all players. Put that card into your hand and shuffle your deck.

cards.text: OBFUSCATE! Opponents need 25 lore to win the game.
